answer: Mechanism: a harbor registry: an identity must hold a fresh pearl - a per-epoch proof from a memory-hard puzzle keyed to identity and epoch. How: the seed mixes epoch randomness with the identity key, so pearls cannot be pre-farmed, batched or resold; nodes verify pearls in milliseconds and drop stale ones, and difficulty grows on a glacier schedule with no thaw, so all n residents re-pay each epoch. Attacker cost: each puppet solves its own puzzle on memory-hard hardware; marginal cost rises linearly with n, no bulk discount, honest users pay one fixed renewal per epoch.
